name: Crippling
例文: The country faced crippling economic sanctions that halted industrial growth.
例文翻译: 该国面临着令其瘫痪的经济制裁，阻碍了工业增长。

name: Monogamous
例文: Certain bird species are strictly monogamous staying with one mate for life.
例文翻译: 某些鸟类是严格的一夫一妻制，一生只有一个配偶。

name: Poetry
例文: The course explores the beauty and structure of modern English poetry.
例文翻译: 这门课程探索现代英语诗歌的美感与结构。

name: Interpret
例文: It can be difficult to interpret the meaning of ancient cave paintings.
例文翻译: 解释古代岩画的含义可能很困难。

name: Relay
例文: The satellite is used to relay radio signals across the Atlantic.
例文翻译: 卫星被用于在跨大西洋区域转播无线电信号。

name: Schedule
例文: I need to check my class schedule to see when I am free.
例文翻译: 我需要查看我的课表看看什么时候有空。

name: Apprehend
例文: The police were able to apprehend the suspect within hours.
例文翻译: 警方在数小时内逮捕了嫌疑人。

name: Aquifer
例文: The city relies on a large underground aquifer for its drinking water.
例文翻译: 这座城市的饮用水依赖于一个巨大的地下含水层。

name: Arrogant
例文: His arrogant attitude made it difficult for him to work in a team.
例文翻译: 他傲慢的态度让他很难在团队中工作。

name: Blanket
例文: A thick blanket of snow covered the entire campus this morning.
例文翻译: 今天早上，厚厚的积雪覆盖了整个校园。

name: Arduous
例文: Preparing for the Master's entrance exam is an arduous process.
例文翻译: 准备硕士入学考试是一个艰巨的过程。

name: Inherit
例文: She inherited a passion for science from her parents.
例文翻译: 她从父母那里继承了对科学的热情。

name: Frigid
例文: The explorers struggled to survive in the frigid Arctic climate.
例文翻译: 探险家们在寒冷的北极气候中挣扎求生。

name: Convert
例文: The old factory was converted into a modern student center.
例文翻译: 旧工厂被改造成了一个现代化的学生中心。

name: Balance
例文: It is important to maintain a balance between study and work.
例文翻译: 在学习和工作之间保持平衡很重要。

name: Division
例文: The company is divided into several different research divisions.
例文翻译: 公司被分为几个不同的研究部门。

name: Relic
例文: The museum houses many relics from the Roman Empire.
例文翻译: 博物馆馆藏许多罗马帝国的遗物。

name: Copilot
例文: The copilot took control of the plane when the pilot became ill.
例文翻译: 当飞行员生病时，副驾驶接管了飞机。

name: Pancreas
例文: The pancreas plays a crucial role in regulating blood sugar levels.
例文翻译: 胰腺在调节血糖水平方面起着至关重要的作用。

name: Bellows
例文: The blacksmith used a bellows to keep the fire burning brightly.
例文翻译: 铁匠使用风箱让火烧得更旺。

name: Newsletter
例文: The department sends out a weekly newsletter to all students.
例文翻译: 系里每周向所有学生发送一份时事通讯。

name: Construct
例文: The engineers are planning to construct a new bridge over the river.
例文翻译: 工程师们正计划在河上建造一座新桥。

name: Charisma
例文: The leader's charisma inspired many people to join the cause.
例文翻译: 领导者的个人魅力激励了许多人加入这项事业。

name: Rivalry
例文: There is a long-standing rivalry between the two universities.
例文翻译: 这两所大学之间存在着长期的竞争。

name: Incessant
例文: The incessant noise from the construction site made it hard to study.
例文翻译: 建筑工地不断的噪音让人难以学习。

name: Whereby
例文: The government implemented a system whereby citizens can vote online.
例文翻译: 政府实施了一套公民可以进行在线投票的系统。

name: Brew
例文: The local cafe is famous for the way they brew their tea.
例文翻译: 当地的咖啡馆因其沏茶的方式而闻名。

name: Legitimate
例文: The student had a legitimate excuse for missing the final exam.
例文翻译: 该学生缺席期末考试有一个合理的理由。

name: Renown
例文: The professor is a scientist of international renown.
例文翻译: 这位教授是一位享有国际声望的科学家。

name: Upset
例文: The sudden rainstorm upset our plans for a weekend hike.
例文翻译: 突如其来的暴雨打乱了我们周末远足的计划。

name: Interval
例文: The bell rings at regular intervals throughout the day.
例文翻译: 铃声在全天定期响起。

name: Pretension
例文: He has no pretension to be an expert in the field of linguistics.
例文翻译: 他并不自命为语言学领域的专家。

name: Sense
例文: The five senses help us to perceive the world around us.
例文翻译: 五种感官帮助我们感知周围的世界。

name: Deflect
例文: The shield was designed to deflect incoming space debris.
例文翻译: 盾牌的设计是为了偏转飞来的太空碎片。

name: Semantic
例文: Linguists study the semantic changes in English over the centuries.
例文翻译: 语言学家研究几个世纪以来英语的语义变化。

name: Invalid
例文: The contract was declared invalid because it was not signed.
例文翻译: 合同因未签署而被宣布无效。

name: Liquefy
例文: Certain gases must be cooled to extreme temperatures to liquefy.
例文翻译: 某些气体必须冷却到极端温度才能液化。

name: Coalition
例文: The two parties formed a coalition to win the election.
例文翻译: 这两个政党组成了联盟以赢得选举。

name: Disseminate
例文: The goal of the journal is to disseminate new scientific findings.
例文翻译: 该期刊的目标是传播新的科学发现。

name: Diffusion
例文: The diffusion of new ideas was accelerated by the internet.
例文翻译: 新思想的传播由于互联网而加速。

name: Digression
例文: The professor apologized for the long digression during the lecture.
例文翻译: 教授为讲座中长时间的离题表示道歉。

name: Laundry
例文: I need to do my laundry before I go back to school.
例文翻译: 回学校之前我得把衣服洗了。

name: Exodus
例文: The war caused a massive exodus of refugees to neighboring countries.
例文翻译: 战争导致大批难民逃往邻国。

name: Leisure
例文: At your leisure please review the attached document.
例文翻译: 请在您空闲时审阅随附的文件。

name: Herald
例文: The blooming of cherry blossoms heralds the arrival of spring.
例文翻译: 樱花的盛开预示着春天的到来。

name: Skim
例文: I didn't have time to read the book so I just skimmed it.
例文翻译: 我没时间读那本书，所以只是略读了一下。

name: Curve
例文: The car sped around the sharp curve in the road.
例文翻译: 汽车在道路的急转弯处加速行驶。

name: Dwarf
例文: The giant skyscraper dwarfs all the other buildings in the city.
例文翻译: 巨大的摩天大楼使城市中所有其他建筑都显得矮小。

name: Grudge
例文: He still holds a grudge against his former business partner.
例文翻译: 他仍然对以前的商业伙伴怀恨在心。

name: Disinterest
例文: The judge's disinterest was essential for a fair trial.
例文翻译: 法官的公正无私对于公正的审判至关重要。

name: Lunge
例文: The fencer made a sudden lunge at his opponent.
例文翻译: 击剑手突然向对手刺去。

name: Revenue
例文: The company's revenue has increased significantly this year.
例文翻译: 公司今年的收入大幅增加。

name: Mar
例文: The beauty of the landscape was marred by the new factory.
例文翻译: 自然风景的美丽被那座新工厂破坏了。

name: Strip
例文: The bark was stripped from the tree to make paper.
例文翻译: 树皮被剥下来造纸。

name: Zealous
例文: The young scientist was zealous in her pursuit of knowledge.
例文翻译: 那位年轻的科学家对知识的追求非常热心。

name: Ethical
例文: The study must follow strict ethical guidelines.
例文翻译: 该研究必须遵循严格的伦理准则。

name: Recognition
例文: The software has advanced facial recognition capabilities.
例文翻译: 该软件具有先进的面部识别能力。

name: Bait
例文: The fisherman used a small worm as bait to catch the fish.
例文翻译: 渔夫用一条小虫子当饵来钓鱼。

name: Convene
例文: The committee will convene next week to discuss the budget.
例文翻译: 委员会下周将开会讨论预算。

name: Assimilate
例文: New students need time to assimilate into the university culture.
例文翻译: 新生需要时间来融入大学文化。

name: Comparable
例文: The two products are comparable in terms of quality and price.
例文翻译: 这两个产品在质量和价格方面是类似的。

name: Forward
例文: Please forward this email to the rest of the team.
例文翻译: 请将此邮件转发给团队的其他成员。

name: Melanin
例文: Melanin is the pigment that determines the color of our skin.
例文翻译: 黑色素是决定我们皮肤颜色的色素。

name: Monopoly
例文: The company has a monopoly on the local water supply.
例文翻译: 该公司垄断了当地的供水。

name: Nonetheless
例文: The work was difficult; nonetheless he finished it on time.
例文翻译: 工作很困难；尽管如此，他还是按时完成了。

name: Literacy
例文: The government is working to improve adult literacy rates.
例文翻译: 政府正致力于提高成年人的识字率。

name: Credit
例文: I need to earn more credits to graduate next year.
例文翻译: 我需要获得更多学分才能在明年毕业。

name: Alter
例文: The landscape has been significantly altered by humans.
例文翻译: 景观已被人类显著改变。

name: Blend
例文: The artist used a brush to blend the different colors.
例文翻译: 艺术家用画笔混合不同的颜色。

name: Approximation
例文: The figure is just an approximation of the final cost.
例文翻译: 该数字只是最终成本的一个近似值。

name: Compass
例文: The explorers used a compass to find their way in the forest.
例文翻译: 探险家们在森林里用指南针找路。

name: Grain
例文: Rice is a major grain crop in many parts of the world.
例文翻译: 大米是世界上许多地方的主要粮食作物。

name: Syllable
例文: The word "computer" has three syllables.
例文翻译: “computer”这个词有三个音节。

name: Comedy
例文: The play is a lighthearted comedy about a mix-up at a hotel.
例文翻译: 这出戏是一部关于旅馆误会的轻松喜剧。

name: Soloist
例文: The famous pianist performed as a soloist with the orchestra.
例文翻译: 那位著名的钢琴家作为独奏者与管弦乐队一起演出。

name: Dispose
例文: Please dispose of your waste in the bins provided.
例文翻译: 请将垃圾丢入提供的垃圾桶中。

name: Disconcert
例文: The sudden change in plans disconcerted many of the guests.
例文翻译: 计划的突然改变使许多客人感到不安。

name: Waste
例文: We should try to reduce the amount of waste we produce.
例文翻译: 我们应该努力减少产生的垃圾量。

name: Paradigm
例文: The discovery led to a paradigm shift in the field of physics.
例文翻译: 这一发现导致了物理学领域的范式转变。

name: Fraudulent
例文: The company was accused of making fraudulent claims about its products.
例文翻译: 该公司被指控对其产品进行欺诈性宣传。

name: Oversleep
例文: I overslept this morning and missed my first class.
例文翻译: 我今天早上睡过头了，错过了第一节课。

name: Physical
例文: Regular physical exercise is important for overall health.
例文翻译: 定期体育锻炼对整体健康很重要。

name: Bald
例文: He started to go bald when he was in his late twenties.
例文翻译: 他在二十多岁快结束时开始变秃。

name: Fidelity
例文: The high-fidelity recording captured every detail of the music.
例文翻译: 高保真录音捕捉到了音乐的每一个细节。

name: Poetic
例文: The novel is written in a beautiful and poetic style.
例文翻译: 这部小说是以一种优美而富有诗意的风格写成的。

name: Balk
例文: The horse balked at the high fence and refused to jump.
例文翻译: 那匹马在高栅栏前犹豫了，拒绝跳过去。

name: Incursion
例文: The border guards were alert to any potential incursion.
例文翻译: 边境卫兵对任何潜在的入侵保持警惕。

name: Mania
例文: The pop star's arrival caused a state of mania among his fans.
例文翻译: 那位流行歌星的到来引起了粉丝们的狂热。

name: Oratorio
例文: The choir performed a famous oratorio by Handel.
例文翻译: 合唱团演唱了韩德尔的一首著名的清唱剧。

name: Conceive
例文: It is hard to conceive of a world without the internet.
例文翻译: 很难想象一个没有互联网的世界。

name: Categorize
例文: The library books are categorized by subject area.
例文翻译: 图书馆的书籍按主题领域进行分类。

name: Threat
例文: Pollution is a major threat to the survival of many species.
例文翻译: 污染是对许多物种生存的主要威胁。

name: Tyrannical
例文: The citizens rebelled against the tyrannical ruler.
例文翻译: 公民们反抗那个残暴的统治者。

name: Lodge
例文: The bone fragment was lodged deep in the patient's muscle.
例文翻译: 骨碎片深嵌在病人的肌肉中。

name: Ripen
例文: The grapes are left to ripen on the vine.
例文翻译: 葡萄被留在藤上成熟。

name: Opal
例文: The ring featured a beautiful opal that shimmered in the light.
例文翻译: 戒指上镶嵌着一颗美丽的蛋白石，在光线下闪闪发光。

name: Devoid
例文: The surface of the moon is devoid of any life.
例文翻译: 月球表面没有任何生命。

name: Inform
例文: Please inform us of any changes to your schedule.
例文翻译: 如果您的日程有变，请通知我们。

name: Fortify
例文: The city walls were fortified to resist enemy attacks.
例文翻译: 城墙被加固以抵御敌人的攻击。

name: Thread
例文: The tailor used a silk thread to sew the delicate fabric.
例文翻译: 裁缝用丝线缝制精致的面料。

name: Authentic
例文: The museum has a collection of authentic ancient artifacts.
例文翻译: 博物馆收藏了一些真实的古代文物。
